facts.fact: StackAdapt's recommended common strategy tracks time-on-site and loads the Google Ads remarketing pixel only after a user has spent at least 15 seconds on content.
facts.quote: Track time-on-site and load the Google Ads remarketing pixel after the user has spent at least 15 seconds on content

facts.fact: The article's eMarketer-sourced bar graph on the most effective types of content is dated July 2017.
facts.quote: Bar graph showing most effective types of content, July 2017

facts.fact: According to eMarketer, users prefer to consume credible, trustworthy content about brands.
facts.quote: According to [eMarketer](https://www.emarketer.com/), users prefer to consume credible, trustworthy content about brands.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article states the programmatic campaign goal is to keep paid search CPA constant while growing the number of conversions.
facts.quote: The goal should be to keep the CPA on the paid search channel constant, while growing the number of conversions.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes programmatic as a mid-funnel strategy because of how purchase intent is derived.
facts.quote: Programmatic is a mid-funnel strategy because of the way the purchase intent is derived.

facts.fact: StackAdapt recommends that the landing page for programmatic native performance campaigns be ungated content.
facts.quote: To make programmatic, and especially programmatic native successful for performance campaigns, the landing page should provide ungated content.

facts.fact: The most common client strategy described combines multiple targeting approaches (custom, lookalike, and 3rd-party audiences) to deliver native ads programmatically.
facts.quote: Leveraging multiple targeting strategies (custom, lookalike, and 3rd-party audiences) to deliver native ads programmatically.
